consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: identification of every energy source for the task
mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.title: audit finding - engineering change note not applied to TK-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the identification of every energy source for the task on TK-7104 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically dissipating trapped and residual energy. TK-7104 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the identification of every energy source for the task was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 1 March 2004 a planned spot check of TK-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the identification of every energy source for the task not effective.
